title: See America: Welcome to Montana
coreRelationships: The large central mountain dominates the midground, establishing depth.
The lake and trees are positioned horizontally, creating a visual break and defining the lower landscape.
The teepee and petroglyphs are small, detailed elements contrasting with the vastness of the mountains.
The geometric typography at the top and bottom frames the landscape scene.
The limited, earthy color palette unifies all elements into a cohesive, retro aesthetic.
reuseFormula: Generate a stylized landscape poster in an Art Deco/WPA style. Use a limited palette of muted earthy browns, blues, and off-whites. Feature a dominant, geometrically-shaped mountain in the midground, with a body of water and stylized trees in front. Include small, culturally relevant foreground elements (e.g., teepee, petroglyphs) rendered with simple, clean lines. Frame the scene with geometric, blocky text at the top and bottom.
